description: Character creation system for Athanor Ascension. 3 backgrounds, 5 specializations, appearance, starting gear.

backgrounds.name: Academic Prodigy
backgrounds.description: Top of your class at ETH Zürich / MIT / Oxford. Theoretical knowledge is perfect. Hands-on experience? Minimal.
backgrounds.unique_ability: Theoretical Insight: See reaction predictions before running them (20% accuracy bonus)
backgrounds.story_hook: Your thesis on 'Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics in Flow Systems' caught Thorne's attention. He pulled strings for your fellowship.

backgrounds.name: Basement Chemist
backgrounds.description: Learned from forums, YouTube, trial and error. No degree. Intuition beats theory. Scars tell stories.
backgrounds.unique_ability: MacGyver Instinct: Improvise equipment from scrap (50% material cost reduction)
backgrounds.story_hook: Your 'incident' with a homemade fluorination rig went viral on chem-forums. Vance tracked you down personally.
backgrounds.dialogue_style: Direct, slang, practical, skeptical of authority

npc_reactions.prof_aris_thorne: Dismissive at first, surprised by results

backgrounds.name: Industry Veteran
backgrounds.description: 10 years at Roche / Pfizer / Novartis. Burned out on corporate politics. Knows GMP, regulations, scale-up. Wants science back.
backgrounds.unique_ability: Process Mastery: Pilot plant recipes run 25% faster, 15% higher yield
backgrounds.story_hook: Your team's Alzheimer's candidate failed Phase III. You walked out with the lab notebook. Lin offered sanctuary.

npc_reactions.prof_aris_thorne: Disdains industry mindset, respects scale-up skills

specializations.name: Synthetic Chemist
specializations.description: Total synthesis, methodology, natural products. The art of making molecules.

specializations.name: Analytical Chemist
specializations.description: Separation, detection, quantification. The science of knowing what you made.

specializations.name: Biochemist
specializations.description: Enzymes, receptors, pathways. The chemistry of life.

specializations.name: Nuclear Chemist
specializations.description: Radioisotopes, actinides, hot cells. The chemistry of the nucleus.

specializations.name: Geneticist
specializations.description: Genomes, CRISPR, synthetic biology. The code of life.

academic.description: Thesis defense → Thorne's office → Fellowship offer → Helicopter to KHI-ACS

hobbyist.description: Basement lab → 'Incident' → Forum fame → Vance's recruitment → Service entrance arrival

ex_pharma.description: Phase III failure → Resignation → Lin's call → Pilot plant arrival
